title: `SpatialData.plot`
text: SpatialData.plot package contains set plotting functions spatial omics data stored SpatialData .zarr files follow OME-NGFF specs. SpatialData object composed five layers: images, labels, shapes, points, tables. layer may contain arbitrary number elements. Images labels represented ZarrArrays (Rarr). Points shapes represented arrow objects linked -disk .parquet file. , data represented memory. Element annotation well cross-layer summarizations (e.g., count matrices) represented SingleCellExperiment tables.
code: x <- file.path("extdata", "blobs.zarr") x <- system.file(x, package="spatialdataR") (x <- readSpatialData(x)) ## class: SpatialData ## - images(2): ##   - blobs_image (3,64,64) ##   - blobs_multiscale_image (3,64,64) ## - labels(2): ##   - blobs_labels (64,64) ##   - blobs_multiscale_labels (64,64) ## - points(1): ##   - blobs_points (200) ## - shapes(3): ##   - blobs_circles (5,circle) ##   - blobs_multipolygons (2,polygon) ##   - blobs_polygons (5,polygon) ## - tables(1): ##   - table (3,10) [blobs_labels] ## coordinate systems(5): ## - global(8): blobs_image blobs_multiscale_image ... blobs_polygons ##   blobs_points ## - scale(1): blobs_labels ## - translation(1): blobs_labels ## - affine(1): blobs_labels ## - sequence(1): blobs_labels

title: `SpatialData.plot`
text: Image/LabelArrays linked potentially multiscale .zarr stores. show method includes scales available given element: Internally, multiscale ImageArrays stored list ZarrArray, e.g.: retrieve specific scale’s ZarrArray, can use data(., k), k specifies target scale. also works plotting:
code: image(x, "blobs_image") ## class:  SpatialDataImage   ## Scales (1): (3,64,64) image(x, "blobs_multiscale_image") ## class:  SpatialDataImage (MultiScale)  ## Scales (3): (3,64,64 3,32,32 3,16,16) i <- image(x, "blobs_multiscale_image") vapply(data(i, k=NULL), dim, numeric(3)) ##      [,1] [,2] [,3] ## [1,]    3    3    3 ## [2,]   64   32   16 ## [3,]   64   32   16 wrap_plots(nrow=1, lapply(seq(3), \(.)      plotSpatialData() + plotImage(x, i=2, k=.)))

title: `SpatialData.plot`
code: i <- "blobs_labels" t <- getTable(x, i) t$id <- sample(letters, ncol(t)) table(x) <- t  p <- plotSpatialData() pal_d <- hcl.colors(10, "Spectral") pal_c <- hcl.colors(9, "Inferno")[-9]  a <- p + plotLabel(x, i, pal="grey")                   # binary b <- p + plotLabel(x, i, c="id", pal=pal_d)            # metadata c <- p + plotLabel(x, i, c="channel_1_sum", pal=pal_c) # assay  (a | b | c) +      plot_layout(guides="collect") &      theme(legend.position="bottom")

title: `SpatialData.plot`
code: i <- "blobs_points" a <- p + plotPoint(x, i) b <- p + plotPoint(x, i, col="genes")       # discrete c <- p + plotPoint(x, i, col="instance_id") # continuous (a | b | c)

code: p <- plotSpatialData() # joint all <- p +     plotImage(x) +     plotLabel(x, a=1/3) +     plotShape(x, 1) +     plotShape(x, 3) +     new_scale_color() +     plotPoint(x, col="genes") +     ggtitle("layered") # split one <- list(     p + plotImage(x) + ggtitle("image"),     p + plotLabel(x) + ggtitle("labels"),     p + plotShape(x, 1) + ggtitle("circles"),     p + plotShape(x, 3) + ggtitle("polygons"),     p + plotPoint(x, col="genes") + ggtitle("points")) wrap_plots(c(list(all), one), nrow=2)

code: x <- file.path("extdata", "blobs.zarr") x <- system.file(x, package="spatialdataR") x <- readSpatialData(x)  # shapes p <- plotSpatialData() a <- p + plotShape(x, "blobs_polygons") #> Coordinate system already present. #> ℹ Adding new coordinate system, which will replace the existing one. b <- p + plotShape(x, "blobs_multipolygons") #> Coordinate system already present. #> ℹ Adding new coordinate system, which will replace the existing one. c <- p + plotShape(x, "blobs_circles") #> Coordinate system already present. #> ℹ Adding new coordinate system, which will replace the existing one. patchwork::wrap_plots(a, b, c)   # layered p +   plotShape(x, "blobs_circles", fill="pink") +   plotShape(x, "blobs_polygons", colour="red") #> Coordinate system already present. #> ℹ Adding new coordinate system, which will replace the existing one. #> Coordinate system already present. #> ℹ Adding new coordinate system, which will replace the existing one.  patchwork::wrap_plots(a, b)   # points i <- "blobs_points" p <- plotSpatialData() p + plotPoint(x, i)                       # simple #> Coordinate system already present. #> ℹ Adding new coordinate system, which will replace the existing one.  p + plotPoint(x, i, colour="genes")       # discrete #> Don't know how to automatically pick scale for object of type <NULL>. #> Defaulting to continuous. #> Coordinate system already present. #> ℹ Adding new coordinate system, which will replace the existing one.  p + plotPoint(x, i, colour="instance_id") # continuous #> Don't know how to automatically pick scale for object of type <NULL>. #> Defaulting to continuous. #> Coordinate system already present. #> ℹ Adding new coordinate system, which will replace the existing one.

title: SpatialData image viz. — plotImage
code: # S4 method for class 'SpatialData' plotImage(   x,   i = 1,   j = 1,   k = NULL,   ch = NULL,   c = NULL,   cl = NULL,   t = NULL,   z = NULL )  plotSpatialData()

title: SpatialData image viz. — plotImage
text: x SpatialData object. element use given layer. j index name target coordinate system. k index scale render; default (NULL), auto-select scale order minimize memory-usage blurring target size 800 x 800px; use Inf plot lowest resolution available. ch image channel(s) used plotting (defaults first channel(s) available); use channels() see channels available given SpatialDataImage c character vector; colors use channel. cl list length-2 numeric vectors (non-negative, increasing); specifies channel-wise contrast limits - defaults [0, 1] (ignored image(x, ) RGB image; convenience, NULL = [0, 1], n = [0, n]). t, z integer scalar indicate specific time- z-slice; left unspecified (default NULL), perform max-projection.

title: SpatialData image viz. — plotImage
code: x <- file.path("extdata", "blobs.zarr") x <- system.file(x, package="spatialdataR") x <- readSpatialData(x, tables=FALSE)  ms <- lapply(seq(3), \(.)    plotSpatialData() +   plotImage(x, i=2, k=.)) patchwork::wrap_plots(ms)   # custom colors cmy <- c("cyan", "magenta", "yellow") plotSpatialData() + plotImage(x, c=cmy)   # contrast limits cl <- rep(list(c(0, 1/3)), 3) plotSpatialData() + plotImage(x, k=1, c=cmy, cl=cl)

title: SpatialData label viz. — plotLabel
text: x SpatialData object. character string index; label element plot. j index name target coordinate system. k index scale render; default (NULL), auto-select scale order minimize memory-usage blurring target size 800 x 800px; use Inf plot lowest resolution available. c determines label colors; default (NULL), gives binary image whether pixel non-zero; alternatively, character string specifying colData column row name annotation table. scalar numeric [0, 1]; alpha value passed geom_tile. pal character vector; color discrete/continuous values (interpolated automatically insufficient values provided). left unspecified, color sampled random. nan character string; color missing values (hidden default). assay character string; case c denoting row name, specifies assay data use (see getTable). t, z integer scalar indicate specific time- z-slice; left unspecified (default NULL), perform max-projection.

title: SpatialData label viz. — plotLabel
code: x <- file.path("extdata", "blobs.zarr") x <- system.file(x, package="spatialdataR") x <- readSpatialData(x)  i <- "blobs_labels" p <- plotSpatialData()  # simple binary image p + plotLabel(x, i)   # mock up some extra data t <- getTable(x, i) t$id <- sample(letters, ncol(t)) table(x) <- t  # coloring by 'colData' p + plotLabel(x, i, c="id")   # coloring by 'assay' data p + plotLabel(x, i,    c="channel_1_sum",    pal=c("lavender", "blue"))

title: SpatialDataArray scalebar — scalebar
code: zs <- file.path("extdata", "blobs.zarr") zs <- system.file(zs, package="spatialdataR") sd <- readSpatialData(zs, tables=FALSE)  # mock unit (data misses specification!) md <- meta(image(sd, 2)) md$multiscales[[1]]$axes[[3]]$unit <- "micron" sd$images[[2]]@meta <- md  plotSpatialData() +    plotImage(sd, i=2) +    scalebar(image(sd, i=2), len=10)
